## Problem and change

Explain the scoped change, relevant subsystem/PW row and design decisions.

## Validation

Exact commands, outcomes, host/toolchain and checks not run. Include deliberate-red
and restoration evidence for new checks; documentation does not need a full
mutation campaign. Distinguish compile, host, QEMU and VMware results.

## Limitations and provenance

Known limits, licensing/provenance of new material, and relevant follow-up work.
Review and understand all changes, including AI-assisted work, before submitting.
